entries.label: syntax, scoped modes, fmt (rust/sql/tofu), clippy, boundaries, cargo-deny, rustdoc, and lightweight
command:
bash -n scripts/dev-check.sh .githooks/pre-commit
      bash scripts/dev-check.sh --help
      bash scripts/dev-check.sh --pre-commit
      CODA_FAST_PRECOMMIT=1 bash .githooks/pre-commit
      bash scripts/dev-check.sh --base origin/main
      cargo fmt --all --check
      python3 scripts/check-sql.py
      for d in infra/gcp/nix-cache infra/gcp/shared-mail infra/gcp/public-site infra/gcp/observability infra/gcp/physician-runtime infra/gcp/rust-environments; do
        tofu fmt -check -recursive "$d"
      done
      cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --quiet -- -D warnings
      cargo clippy -p physician-app -p duet-app -p mobile -p ui-gallery -p extension-popup --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features physician-app/web,duet-app/web,mobile/web,ui-gallery/web,extension-popup/web --quiet -- -D warnings
      cargo test --locked -p boundaries
      cargo deny check
      cargo doc --no-deps --workspace
      (eval "$(sed -n "/^ensure_ci_python()/,/^}/p" scripts/dev-check.sh)"; eval "$(sed -n "/^run_lightweight_checks()/,/^}/p" scripts/dev-check.sh)"; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); run_lightweight_checks)

entries.label: syntax, scoped modes, real fmt, and fail-closed run_stage negative checks
command:
bash -n scripts/dev-check.sh .githooks/pre-commit
      bash scripts/dev-check.sh --help
      bash scripts/dev-check.sh --pre-commit
      bash scripts/dev-check.sh --base origin/main

      eval "$(sed -n "/^tofu_fmt_roots=(/,/^)/p" scripts/dev-check.sh)"
      eval "$(sed -n "/^run_tofu_fmt_checks()/,/^}/p" scripts/dev-check.sh)"
      eval "$(sed -n "/^run_formatting_checks()/,/^}/p" scripts/dev-check.sh)"
      eval "$(sed -n "/^stage_names=(/,/^overall_rc=0/p" scripts/dev-check.sh)"
      eval "$(sed -n "/^run_stage()/,/^}/p" scripts/dev-check.sh)"

      # 1. Positive real check through run_stage
      run_stage "fmt" run_formatting_checks 1
      [ "${stage_statuses[0]}" = "PASS" ]

      # 2. Negative: cargo fmt fails before passing python3 and tofu
      (
        stage_names=(); stage_statuses=(); stage_durations=(); overall_rc=0
        cargo() { return 42; }
        python3() { return 0; }
        tofu() { return 0; }
        set +e
        run_stage "fmt" run_formatting_checks 1
        rc=$?
        set -e
        [ "$rc" -eq 42 ] && [ "${stage_statuses[0]}" = "FAIL(42)" ]
      )

      # 3. Negative: check-sql.py fails before passing tofu
      (
        stage_names=(); stage_statuses=(); stage_durations=(); overall_rc=0
        cargo() { return 0; }
        python3() { return 17; }
        tofu() { return 0; }
        set +e
        run_stage "fmt" run_formatting_checks 1
        rc=$?
        set -e
        [ "$rc" -eq 17 ] && [ "${stage_statuses[0]}" = "FAIL(17)" ]
      )

      # 4. Negative: first OpenTofu root fails while later roots pass
      (
        stage_names=(); stage_statuses=(); stage_durations=(); overall_rc=0
        cargo() { return 0; }
        python3() { return 0; }
        tofu() {
          for arg in "$@"; do
            [ "$arg" = "infra/gcp/nix-cache" ] && return 23
          done
          return 0
        }
        set +e
        run_stage "fmt" run_formatting_checks 1
        rc=$?
        run_tofu_fmt_checks
        tofu_rc=$?
        set -e
        [ "$rc" -eq 23 ] && [ "${stage_statuses[0]}" = "FAIL(23)" ] && [ "$tofu_rc" -eq 23 ]
      )
      echo "ALL_FAIL_CLOSED_CHECKS_PASSED"
entries.superseded: test harness fixed to invoke run_stage inside fresh bash -e -c rather than under ||
